effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of total armour value, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.
choices.name: Teragard's Aegis

assumptions: "Total armour value" is read as the player's total Armour stat from the Loadout screen, which the wiki Armour page derives from equipment tier and slot alone. Level-derived armour, prayer and curse block levels, and Fortitude's x1.15 belong to the hit-chance armour rating and are excluded.
The shield and defender shares are the card's flat 25/50/75%, so the percentage resolves before the single rounding: floor(armour x 0.75), not floor(armour x 0.25) x 3.
Only a genuinely wielded off-hand qualifies; a stored shield or defender under a two-handed weapon does not, and a shield effect granted by an ability is not a wielded shield.
The armour contribution is added to base ability damage before the ability's own damage band.

effects: Damage dealt gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.
choices.name: Big Boned

assumptions: Mod Sponge (Discord): Big Boned is per hit and works with other blessings.

Each Big Boned rider is flat bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life at land tick; it inherits the parent damage instance's critical eligibility and critical outcome, is attached, and is not a separate hit.
Maximum life includes Big Boned +50% and temporary boosts while active (Fortitude, bonfires, thermal baths, Powerburst of vitality).
Works with other blessings on the same parent hits: Inferno of Zamorak and the Cinders bonus-damage instance each receive Big Boned; Big Boned never rides itself.
Still unverified: exact formula stage and hit-cap treatment; any DoT/conjure/poison/reflected edges that differ from the shared rider eligibility policy.

The generation multiplier applies to listed ability adrenaline gains only. Impatient's flat +3, the Jaws of the Abyss bleed grant, Vestments' ultimate refund and a Relentless refund are separate grants and are not multiplied.

reason: Record Big Boned's inherited parent crit state while applying it to Cinders and Inferno damage.
